description: List Picardo’s blood test panels. Each has an ID for get_lab_panel and prepare_order_link, a summary, who it is for, how many tests everyone gets and their subtotal.
name: list_lab_panels

subtotalUsd.description: Price in US dollars of the tests everyone gets, before any blood draw fee. Checkout adds PSA for men and a pregnancy test (hCG) for women. Null when a test is temporarily unavailable.

testCount.description: Tests everyone gets; checkout adds any for one sex only.

title: List lab panels
